title: LLM Behavior Engineering
subtitle: Contracts, Context, Retrieval, and Evaluation
description: A professional guide to making language-model behavior explicit, grounded, measurable, and change-ready across managed and open-weight systems.
author: Komal Nakrani

chapters.title: The Model Is Not the Behavior
chapters.summary: Separate a model response from configured system behavior, outcome evidence, and accountable human authority.

chapters.title: Write the Language-Task Contract
chapters.summary: Turn an ambiguous language feature into measurable states, consequences, non-goals, escalation, and named decision authority.

chapters.title: Reason About Tokens, Attention, and Generation
chapters.summary: Use bounded mechanism knowledge to predict token, template, context, and decoding failure surfaces without anthropomorphism.

chapters.title: Select a Model and Access Posture
chapters.summary: Choose a reversible model and access path from task evidence, hard constraints, responsibility, and lifecycle risk.

chapters.title: Establish a Reproducible Baseline
chapters.summary: Bind every behavior-facing input and version into a replayable baseline with raw evidence, trials, and explicit unknowns.

chapters.title: Engineer Instructions and Messages
chapters.summary: Build a versioned message interface that keeps trusted control separate from untrusted data and tests instruction changes by ablation.

chapters.title: Make Outputs Typed and Bounded
chapters.summary: Turn generated language into a versioned proposal interface with layered validation, provenance checks, and explicit terminal states.

chapters.title: Budget Context Deliberately
chapters.summary: Allocate finite context among control, authorized evidence, history, and output while making every omission and failure state visible.

chapters.title: Design the Retrieval Question
chapters.summary: Decide whether external evidence is needed and specify authority, permission, freshness, evidence units, and no-evidence behavior before choosing retrieval technology.

chapters.title: Build the Retrieval and Reranking Path
chapters.summary: Turn an authorized evidence corpus into a measurable retrieval funnel whose ingestion, chunking, filtering, ranking, and reranking decisions remain separately traceable.

chapters.title: Assemble Context With Provenance
chapters.summary: Convert selected retrieval candidates into an authorized, attributable evidence bundle that preserves source state, trust, qualifying spans, and bounded behavior.

chapters.title: Evaluate Retrieval and Generation Together
chapters.summary: Diagnose corpus, retrieval, assembly, generation, citation, and evaluator behavior independently and jointly without turning one score into causal evidence.

chapters.title: Build Representative Evaluation Cases
chapters.summary: Turn intended use into a documented, segmented, leakage-aware evaluation asset whose coverage and gaps remain explicit.

chapters.title: Name Errors and Judgment Methods
chapters.summary: Turn raw failures into a consequence-aware taxonomy and calibrate deterministic, model, human, domain, and authority judgments without hiding disagreement.

chapters.title: Run Experiments That Isolate Change
chapters.summary: Turn a proposed system change into a preregistered, paired, repeatable comparison with visible segments, uncertainty, confounds, and explicit disposition.

chapters.title: Release, Observe, and Change the Model
chapters.summary: Turn the complete behavior dossier into an authority-bound release, observation, rollback, migration, and adaptation-referral system.

appendicesSummary: Measurement and mechanism refreshers, reusable behavior-system artifacts, provider-neutral companion guidance, runtime and distributed-systems boundaries, terminology and adjacent-role guidance, and publication provenance records.
figureRegistryNote: All 32 figures are original synthetic ImageGen PNG teaching illustrations for the fictional Mosaic Desk case. They explain relationships and decision states; they do not report measured model, product, user, or production outcomes.
